items.source: This subinterface of BeanFactory is not meant to be used in normal application code: Stick to BeanFactory or ListableBeanFactory for typical use cases. This interface is just meant to allow for framework-internal plug'n'play even when needing access to bean factory configuration methods.
items.translation: 此 `BeanFactory` 的子接口并非用于常规应用程序代码：对于典型用例，请坚持使用 `BeanFactory` 或 `ListableBeanFactory`。此接口仅用于在需要访问 Bean 工厂配置方法时，允许框架内部实现即插即用。

items.source: NOTE: This method does not consider ancestor factories. It is only meant for accessing local bean definitions of this factory.
items.translation: 注意：此方法不考虑祖先工厂。它仅用于访问该工厂的本地 Bean 定义。

items.source: Typically triggered after changes to the original bean definitions, for example, after applying a BeanFactoryPostProcessor. Note that metadata for beans which have already been created at this point will be kept around.
items.translation: 通常在原始 bean 定义更改后触发，例如在应用 BeanFactoryPostProcessor 之后。请注意，此时已创建的 bean 的元数据将保留。

items.source: Any such marker is to be removed at the end of the managed bootstrap in preInstantiateSingletons().
items.translation: 任何此类标记都应在受管理的引导结束时的 preInstantiateSingletons() 中移除。

items.source:
This will typically be used by application contexts to register
dependencies that are resolved in other ways, like BeanFactory through
BeanFactoryAware or ApplicationContext through ApplicationContextAware.
items.translation: 这通常由应用程序上下文使用，以注册通过其他方式解析的依赖项，例如通过 `BeanFactoryAware` 接口通过 `BeanFactory`，或通过 `ApplicationContextAware` 接口通过 `ApplicationContext`。

items.source:
By default, only the BeanFactoryAware interface is ignored.
For further types to ignore, invoke this method for each type.
items.translation: 默认情况下，仅忽略 BeanFactoryAware 接口。若要忽略其他类型，请为每种类型调用此方法。

items.source:
This is intended for factory/context references that are supposed
to be autowirable but are not defined as beans in the factory:
for example, a dependency of type ApplicationContext resolved to the
ApplicationContext instance that the bean is living in.
items.translation: 这旨在用于工厂/上下文引用，这些引用本应支持自动注入，但在工厂中未定义为 Bean：例如，类型为 `ApplicationContext` 的依赖项被解析为该 Bean 所在的 `ApplicationContext` 实例。

items.source:
Note: There are no such default types registered in a plain BeanFactory,
not even for the BeanFactory interface itself.
items.translation: 注意：在普通的 BeanFactory 中，没有注册任何此类默认类型，甚至不包括 BeanFactory 接口本身。

items.source: This method checks ancestor factories as well.
items.translation: 此方法也会检查祖先工厂。

items.source:
A returned BeanDefinition object should not be a copy but the original
definition object as registered in the factory. This means that it should
be castable to a more specific implementation type, if necessary.
items.translation: 返回的 BeanDefinition 对象不应是副本，而应是工厂中注册的原始定义对象。这意味着如有必要，它应可转换为更具体的实现类型。

items.source:
Includes bean definition names as well as names of manually registered
singleton instances, with bean definition names consistently coming first,
analogous to how type/annotation specific retrieval of bean names works.
items.translation: 包含 Bean 定义名称以及手动注册的单例实例名称，其中 Bean 定义名称始终排在前面，类似于按类型/注解获取 Bean 名称的方式。

items.source:
This allows the factory to aggressively cache bean definition metadata
going forward, after clearing the initial temporary metadata cache.
items.translation: 这允许工厂在清除初始临时元数据缓存后，从此积极缓存 Bean 定义元数据。

items.source: Ensure that all non-lazy-init singletons are instantiated, also considering FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 确保所有非懒加载单例都得到实例化，同时考虑 FactoryBeans。

items.source: Ensure that all non-lazy-init singletons are instantiated, also considering FactoryBeans. Typically invoked at the end of factory setup, if desired.
items.translation: 确保所有非懒加载单例实例化，同时考虑 FactoryBeans。 通常在工厂设置结束时调用，如果希望如此。

items.source:
Ignore the given dependency type for autowiring:
for example, String. Default is none.
items.translation: 忽略用于自动装配的给定依赖类型，例如 String。默认值为无。

items.source:
Return whether this factory's bean definitions are frozen,
i.e. are not supposed to be modified or post-processed any further.
items.translation: 返回该工厂的 Bean 定义是否已冻结，即不应再对其进行修改或后处理。

items.source: BeansException - if one of the singleton beans could not be created. Note: This may have left the factory with some beans already initialized! Call ConfigurableBeanFactory.destroySingletons() for full cleanup in this case.
items.translation: BeansException - 如果其中一个单例 Bean 无法创建。注意：这可能导致工厂中已初始化了一些 Bean！在这种情况下，请调用 ConfigurableBeanFactory.destroySingletons() 进行彻底清理。

items.source: autowiredValue - the corresponding autowired value. This may also be an implementation of the ObjectFactory interface, which allows for lazy resolution of the actual target value.
items.translation: autowiredValue - 对应的自动注入值。这也可能是 ObjectFactory 接口的一个实现，该接口允许对实际目标值进行延迟解析。

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean with the given name defined in this factory
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果此工厂中未定义具有给定名称的 Bean

items.source: type - the dependency type to ignore
items.translation: type - 要忽略的依赖类型

items.source: ifc - the dependency interface to ignore
items.translation: ifc - 要忽略的依赖接口

items.source: dependencyType - the dependency type to register. This will typically be a base interface such as BeanFactory, with extensions of it resolved as well if declared as an autowiring dependency (for example, ListableBeanFactory), as long as the given value actually implements the extended interface.
items.translation: `dependencyType` - 要注册的依赖类型。这通常是一个基础接口，例如 BeanFactory；如果将其声明为自动装配的依赖（例如 ListableBeanFactory），其扩展也会被解析，前提是给定的值确实实现了该扩展接口。

items.source: true if the factory's configuration is considered frozen
items.translation: true 表示工厂的配置被视为已冻结。

items.source: whether the bean should be considered as autowire candidate
items.translation: bean 是否应被视为自动注入候选者

items.source: the registered BeanDefinition
items.translation: 已注册的 BeanDefinition

items.source: the composite iterator for the bean names view
items.translation: bean names view 的复合迭代器

items.source:
Clear the merged bean definition cache, removing entries for beans
which are not considered eligible for full metadata caching yet.
items.translation: 清除合并的 Bean 定义缓存，移除那些尚未被认为符合完整元数据缓存条件的 Bean 的条目。

items.source:
Freeze all bean definitions, signalling that the registered bean definitions
will not be modified or post-processed any further.
items.translation: 冻结所有 Bean 定义，表示已注册的 Bean 定义将不再被修改或进行后续处理。

items.source:
Return the registered BeanDefinition for the specified bean, allowing access
to its property values and constructor argument value (which can be
modified during bean factory post-processing).
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 的已注册 BeanDefinition，以便访问其属性值和构造函数参数值（这些值可以在 Bean 工厂后处理期间进行修改）。

items.source: Return a unified view over all bean names managed by this factory.
items.translation: 返回该工厂管理的所有 Bean 名称的统一视图。

items.source: Ignore the given dependency interface for autowiring.
items.translation: 忽略用于自动装配的给定依赖接口。

items.source:
Ignore the given dependency type for autowiring:
for example, String.
items.translation: 忽略用于自动装配的给定依赖类型，例如 String。

items.source:
Determine whether the specified bean qualifies as an autowire candidate,
to be injected into other beans which declare a dependency of matching type.
items.translation: 确定指定的 Bean 是否为自动装配候选者，以便注入到声明了匹配类型依赖的其他 Bean 中。

items.source:
Mark current thread as main bootstrap thread for singleton instantiation,
with lenient bootstrap locking applying for background threads.
items.translation: 将当前线程标记为主引导线程，用于单例实例化，并对后台线程应用宽松的引导锁。

items.source: Register a special dependency type with corresponding autowired value.
items.translation: 注册具有相应注入值的特殊依赖类型。

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean with the given name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在具有给定名称的 Bean

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean to check
items.translation: beanName - 要检查的 Bean 的名称

items.source: descriptor - the descriptor of the dependency to resolve
items.translation: descriptor - 要解析的依赖项的描述符

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称
